label: selling-agent-buyer_console
request_preview: I need three kettles but your price is above what I budgeted. What is the best you can actually do?

json.message: For a three-kettle order, I can offer an immediate 8% discount, bringing each unit down to ₹4,591. If you are ready to finalize today or want to add another item like a blender to the basket, I might be able to sweeten the deal further.
json.rationale: Opening with an initial 8% discount on a three-unit request to keep room below our 15% ceiling while testing the buyer's urgency and interest in bundling.
